judgments.reason: The MRI description explicitly states 'a 5 × 10-mm irregular lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen,' which directly supports the anatomical localization of the schwannoma to the right mastoid/stylomastoid foramen region.
The CT findings explicitly mention 'expansion of the stylomastoid foramen,' which directly supports the stylomastoid foramen component of the anatomical modifier.
